axis: C1 calibration 7->7: promisor metadata vs unavailable required evidence

arms.name: control_full_clone
arms.note: the registered URL is exempt because corpus/SOURCES.md is readable; the cited lane commit is present

arms.name: treatment_promisor
arms.lane: blob:none clone of the origin lane: promisor-marked, committed corpus/SOURCES.md blob absent locally
expect_stderr_excludes_any: does not appear to be a git repository
Could not read from remote repository
arms.note: REQUIRED EVIDENCE UNAVAILABLE => exit 2. Never exit 0 (clean) and never exit 1 (failed). The reason must be content, not the metadata-only refusal 'partial clone ...'.

arms.name: probe_metadata_stripped
arms.lane: copy of treatment_promisor with the promisor metadata removed and the blob still absent
arms.note: the path the r24 repair must take once promisor metadata is accepted: the missing blob decides, exit 2

arms.name: legacy_exemption
arms.lane: lane that never committed corpus/SOURCES.md (same fleet report)
arms.note: DOCUMENTARY ARM, not a pass criterion: this is the exemption signature. A repair that treats an unreadable committed registry as legacy-absent reproduces exactly this on treatment_promisor.

arms.name: treatment_no_remote
arms.lane: blob:none clone whose remote URL points at a nonexistent local path
arms.note: identical stderr (repo path normalised) proves the promisor remote was never contacted

invariants.no_lazy_fetch: the set of object ids in the lane clone's local object store must be identical before and after every audit run; the missing SOURCES blob must never appear in it
invariants.no_network_transport: the only remote is a local file:// path (local synthetic fixture)
invariants.no_execution_payload: no remote program, hook or command is configured or triggered
invariants.no_config_caused_hang: every git call inside the auditor keeps its 20s deadline; the fixture's git calls use a 60s ceiling
